{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZgKoCg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDHUNg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 41, "title": "Reject pending reference-space requests when XRSession shuts down", "body": "## Problem

At `dev` commit `938adc9e5acd7d164c394fc27dbbc89593adbda3`, reference-space requests queue allocation/rejection without registering pending operations for shutdown. `_finish()` cannot cancel them. Calling `requestReferenceSpace('viewer')` immediately before `end()` therefore allows startup code to continue after teardown. `tests/reference-space.ts` explicitly expects this behavior.

## Expected outcome

Correct the pending-request lifecycle while retaining the conversion, identity, realm and geometry improvements delivered by #39/#40.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Relevant files: `src/polyfill/api/runtime.ts`, `interface-brand.ts`, `EmulatedXRDevice.ts`, `tests/reference-space.ts`, `tests/reference-space-browser.ts`, and reference-space documentation/inventory. The implementation uses maintained TypeScript, gl-matrix and session-realm allocation closures; no dependency upgrade is indicated. `_finish()` serves explicit end and device-driven termination.

**Retained AI requirement correction:** #39/#40 corrected an earlier blanket ended-session rejection assumption, but incorrectly extended support-based settlement to requests already pending at shutdown. **Correction:** [Device CRD 2026-06-09 §4.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/#xrsession-interface) requires shutdown to reject outstanding session promises with `InvalidStateError`, excluding `end()` promises. **Rationale:** the absence of an ended gate in the request/support algorithms does not override shutdown. Separately initiated post-shutdown requests retain the pinned support/allocation behavior.

All 40 existing Issues/PRs are closed. This addresses a newly identified regression, rather than reopening the full #39 scope. Its [execution report](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/938adc9e5acd7d164c394fc27dbbc89593adbda3/docs/webxr-reference-space-validation-2026-10-24.json) reports 995 assertions per browser, including incorrect shutdown expectations. Those passes do not validate the correction. Pinned [Three.js r186](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8/src/renderers/webxr/WebXRManager.js#L526) awaits reference-space creation during startup.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Track pending reference requests per owning session after binding conversion. Shutdown rejects outstanding granted and ungranted requests exactly once with `InvalidStateError`; previously settled outcomes remain unchanged and `end()` retains its own lifecycle.
- [ ] Guard delayed adapter continuations and queued allocation/rejection callbacks after cancellation. Release pending-operation records and prevent stale allocation, presentation/input restart or disposed-resource recreation. Shutting down one session does not cancel another session's requests.
- [ ] Preserve post-shutdown support-based task settlement, fresh session-realm objects, bounded subclasses, receiver validation and conversion errors. Cover coercion that itself ends the session so promise-creation timing is distinguished correctly.
- [ ] Extend the existing focused fixtures with deterministic races: shutdown before queued settlement, delayed adapter success/failure after shutdown, already settled requests, multiple concurrent requests, borrowed methods and device-driven shutdown. Observe rejection reactions without retaining the incorrect microtask-pending assertion or assuming ordering between unrelated task sources. Disclose any targeted instrumentation.
- [ ] Preserve existing negotiation: immersive `viewer`/`local` defaults; explicit `local-floor`, `bounded-floor`, `unbounded`; viewer-only inline; Quest selected VR/MR modes; Android AR without immersive VR. Retain #39 conversion, independent offsets, moving-viewer, geometry and ownership acceptance.
- [ ] Coordinator runs `npm run build:firefox`, both `test:reference-space:chromium` and `test:reference-space:firefox` scripts, and `git diff --check`. Record actual outcomes across the five existing scenarios, browser/tool versions, source/bundle hashes, failures and skips. These are focused change checks; add no generic application rerun or independent AI re-review.
- [ ] Correct documentation/inventory and add versioned execution evidence. Preserve historical reports with an explicit correction reference. Retain the original assumption, correction, primary source and rationale in this Issue/resulting PR. Further mistaken AI requirements may be corrected through the same evidence record without human approval or independent AI re-review; preserve the goal and meaningful acceptance.

## Optional validation

None required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. The Coordinator owns implementation, tests and normal PR review.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
